findings.text: follow-on: store_operand, load_operand, operand_digest and operand_cache_directory (lines 33-81) re-implement content-addressed atomic publication the repository already owns at nova/database/content_store.py (sha256_bytes, publish_files, verified_object_root) and which nova/imas/machine_artifact.py:751 and nova/database/layer_fetch.py:148 already use; the addition neither extends nor wraps that owner, and the source-file digest idiom it also introduces already exists at nova/circuit/coupled_plant.py:473 and nova/circuit/passive.py:101.

follow-on: assembly_seconds is now the stored build wall plus this call's load on a cache hit, so a receipt consumer reads an assembly cost the process never paid, and scripts/prototypes/lean_map/jets.py:57 applies the same substitution in the jet receipt.

follow-on: load_seconds is timed around load_operand alone while the memmap is materialised here and copied again by jnp.asarray at values.py:116 outside the timed window, so the 3.7 ms load figure in the evidence fragment prices the mmap open rather than getting the 1.9 GB matrix in hand.

follow-on: the only guard for the jet default-on path is marked slow and the recorded gate deselected it (gate-values.log, 2 deselected), so build_jet_matrix's persist default and build_jets' default have no guard in the recorded evidence.

follow-on: no baseline_suite line is recorded, so added_failure_count 0 and added_failure_ids [] are derived from after_suite alone and the delta cannot be checked against a base arm; defensible for a newly added test file, but the record does not say so.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against b713929c8; 8bdb995f1 adds the cache and both defaults, 296f137f6 records the fragment, 48c35ddf7/98c5627f2/7eb4234f3 add the measured H200 rows, all six changed paths inside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the named gate tests/test_operand_cache.py is recorded green at gate-values.log (4 passed, 2 deselected, EXIT=0), but the two deselected arms (the jet default-on arm and the two-process arm at concurrency.log 1 passed) are outside the recorded run and the manifest carries no baseline_suite arm.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal makes cached Biot-Savart value and jet operands the default; scripts/prototypes/lean_map/values.py:60 persists the flux-block matrix by default and scripts/prototypes/read_route/jets.py:148 takes persist=True, both resolving one root at nova/database/filepath.py:35, and os.replace publication makes a partial matrix invisible.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records status complete, five commits, the negative-control log path and note, after_suite at 8bdb995f1 with failure_count 0, the artifacts and four follow-ons, and no baseline_suite line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven paths plus a figures directory; git diff b713929c86bf05821e06936b30e959c3a0ee6317..7eb4234f3304e5db28102850a42d6d1b1c0d6e00 touches only the six declared non-figure paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_operand_cache.py:156 and :182 redden on the declared mutation (negative-control.log, 2 failed with the same digest on both sides), so the miss guards are real, but the jet default-on guard at tests/test_operand_cache.py:228 is slow and was deselected by the recorded gate.
justifications.evidence: gate-values.log records the run with its revision, tree and command and EXIT=0, yet the load wall it reports times only the mmap open and the jets default arm is not in the recorded evidence.
justifications.fit: the added names (operand_digest, operand_cache_root, values_digest) are descriptive with no plan or ticket label, but scripts/prototypes/lean_map/values.py has no trailing newline and defines a second source_bytes shadowing scripts/prototypes/read_route/jets.py:26 with different contents.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/lean_map/values.py:60 and scripts/prototypes/read_route/jets.py:148 make persistence the default on both builders and nova/database/filepath.py:35 is the one root, meeting the goal without changing the matrices' numerical content.
justifications.reuse: scripts/prototypes/read_route/jets.py:33-81 defines a content-addressed store with atomic publication that nova/database/content_store.py already owns and that the node does not extend or wrap.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff b713929c86bf05821e06936b30e959c3a0ee6317..7eb4234f3304e5db28102850a42d6d1b1c0d6e00 is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
